card.name: Digits just before ordinal endings
card.fires_on: A digit inside a number that is about to take an ordinal ending such as st, nd, rd or th. It shows up in rankings, dates, dose-reduction steps and occurrence counts.

modes.label: Ordinal numbers
modes.description: The last digit of a number that is followed by st, nd, rd or th in lists, ranks and dates.
modes.example: we can speak of the contestants as having come 1st, 2nd, <<3>>rd etc.

modes.label: Dose-reduction steps
modes.description: A digit in a label table that counts reductions or occurrences, with the ordinal ending written as a separate piece.
modes.example: 1 st Dose Reduction <<2>> nd Dose Reduction 3 rd D
